concurrency_test: Paused catalog commit permits reads of the affected and unrelated inodes and native writes to another inode; conflicting mutations wait; release/forget pins survive through reply capture.
durability: Namespace timestamp commits use WAL/NORMAL; file and directory fsync perform a nonempty FULL catalog transaction before native sync; content publication remains FULL
barrier_tests: FULL mode enforced by SQL trigger; file/directory/datasync boundaries; injected failure propagation and reservation release; sealed namespace metadata survives daemon kill after fsync
